item.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/constants.ts'
s=open(p).read()
old='''/**
 * After any gate ran out of budget, gates wait at most this long for this
 * long: hook passes are serialized, so waits across threads add up.
 */
export const GATE_BREAKER_MS = 60 * 1000;
export const GATE_BREAKER_BUDGET_MS = 500;'''
new='''/**
 * Hook passes are serialized server-wide, so gate waits across threads add
 * up. For GATE_BREAKER_MS after any gate runs out of budget, gates wait at
 * most GATE_BREAKER_BUDGET_MS.
 */
export const GATE_BREAKER_MS = 60 * 1000;
export const GATE_BREAKER_BUDGET_MS = 500;'''
assert old in s; s=s.replace(old,new); open(p,'w').write(s)

p='src/format.ts'
s=open(p).read()
old='''    ...formatPlan(outcome.plan, { applied: true }),
    ...formatVerification(outcome.verification),
  ];'''
new='''    ...formatPlan(outcome.plan, { applied: true }),
    ...formatVerification(outcome.verification),
    ...outcome.warnings.map((warning) => `Warning: ${warning}`),
  ];'''
assert old in s; s=s.replace(old,new); open(p,'w').write(s)

p='src/ui/actions.tsx'
s=open(p).read()
old='''  const verified = outcome.verification?.ok === false ? " Verification found differences; see the Checkpoints panel." : "";
  return `${parts.join(", ")}.${verified}`;'''
new='''  const verified = outcome.verification?.ok === false ? " Verification found differences; see the Checkpoints panel." : "";
  const warnings = outcome.warnings.length > 0 ? ` ${outcome.warnings.join(" ")}` : "";
  return `${parts.join(", ")}.${verified}${warnings}`;'''
assert old in s; s=s.replace(old,new)
old='''  const show = outcome.verification?.ok === false ? toast.warning : toast.success;'''
new='''  const show = outcome.verification?.ok === false || outcome.warnings.length > 0 ? toast.warning : toast.success;'''
assert old in s; s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)

# app test fixtures need warnings
p='test/app.test.tsx'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('''verification: { ok: true, mismatches: [], mismatchCount: 0, untouched: [], untouchedCount: 0 } }),''','''verification: { ok: true, mismatches: [], mismatchCount: 0, untouched: [], untouchedCount: 0 }, warnings: [] }),''')
s=s.replace('''          verification: { ok: true, mismatches: [], mismatchCount: 0, untouched: [], untouchedCount: 0 },
        }),''','''          verification: { ok: true, mismatches: [], mismatchCount: 0, untouched: [], untouchedCount: 0 },
          warnings: [],
        }),''')
open(p,'w').write(s)

# git.ts: test hook to recompute the base env
p='src/host/git.ts'
s=open(p).read()
old='''/** Kill every git process this worker started (worker dispose). */'''
new='''/** Tests change HOME to fake a global git config; forget the cached env. */
export function resetGitBaseEnv(): void {
  baseEnv = null;
}

/** Kill every git process this worker started (worker dispose). */'''
assert old in s; s=s.replace(old,new); open(p,'w').write(s)
print("ok")
EOF
npx vitest run 2>&1 | tail -30
